name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley, holding the handle in one hand with your arm extended behind your body.
Keep your upper arm behind your torso and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower with control to a full stretch.
Avoid swinging your body. Complete all reps, then switch arms.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with their back to the low cable stack, one arm extended straight behind the body holding the handle, cable running back to the stack behind the legs.
